title: Veil-rays at GSC-0027 Prism Scatter; verdigris curd sold at Central Nexus
note: Six veil-rays counted 2026-11-15 15:09 UTC; 16 to 18 from 22:32 to 23:06 UTC while one hunter worked here. Ranched from 2026-11-15 17:40 UTC: no hunt below four animals and four kills a run. Railgun test 2026-11-15 21:55 to 22:54 UTC (orders.log ENT-005): three runs of the railgun ship, 4, 4 and 0 kills; the two trips with 4 kills took 21.4 and 24.0 minutes against 21.7 to 26.8 for the eight pulse-laser trips with 4 kills here (18:20 to 21:28 UTC); the 8 slug cases bought for it ran out in the third run, which fled with no ammunition. No gain measured: from 2026-11-15 23:28 UTC the route takes every drone again and no ship with a Piercing Railgun I (requires.without_module) until that ship carries ammunition. Sold at Central Nexus: 330 cr a curd. 2026-11-16 09:12 UTC (Apophis): status off. The verdigris curd bid (330 cr x 50) left every station of our books between 07:08 and 07:51 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl) and has not come back; the seven drone veil-ray hunts made -1,851 cr in 21 runs from 07:05 UTC (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Back on when a curd bid of 100 cr or more reads again (the tool market); requires.bid on hunt routes is asked of Unity so that this happens by itself. 2026-11-16 13:09 UTC (Apophis): back on (orders.log ENT-014, block APOPHIS). The verdigris curd bid stood again at 330 cr x 50 at seven stations of our books from 12:07 to 12:21 UTC (data/market/history.jsonl). `requires.bid` names the curd bid of the sell station (100 cr, 4 units): the dispatcher closes the route while a book read within the hour shows it gone and opens it when a docked ship reads it back; `min_bid` 100 so that every bid that opens the route also takes the curd. The loss stop holds it until its losing runs of 07:05 to 09:20 UTC leave the six-hour window.
